description: Temperature transmitters with Modbus RTU over RS-485, a 0-10 V output and a built-in P/PI controller: temperature, controller settings, output range and fixed output override
source: Produal TEKY4-M, TEKY6-M, TEKY6S-M, TEPK-M, TEU-M, TEV-M user guide V1.1.7 (03.05.2019), Modbus section

sources.title: TEKY4-M, TEKY6-M, TEKY6S-M, TEPK-M, TEU-M, TEV-M user guide
sources.note: Modbus bus properties and register tables (page 4 and 5)

notes: Written from the manufacturer's user guide; not tested on a device. For devices with software version 1.1.7 or newer.

Factory defaults: Modbus ID 1, 9.6 kBaud, no parity, 1 stop bit (from the guide's menu). The ID can be set to OFF or 1-247 and the speed to 9.6, 19.2, 38.4, 56.0, 57.6, 76.8 or 115.2 kBaud with the ML-SER tool.
Register numbers start at 1 (coil 1, input 30001, holding 40001), so address_base is 1.
Temperature, offset, set point and proportional band have one decimal place: -500 to 1500 is -50.0 to 150.0 °C.
The measurement range is chosen with the jumpers S1 and S2 (0-50, 0-100, -50-50 or -50-150 °C); the guide does not say that the registers report it.

Registers marked with * in the guide (output overdrive value, fixed control output value, fixed control output timer and time left) are kept in volatile memory and return to their defaults after a power failure.
To set the fixed output time more exactly, write the output value to holding register 9 and the time in minutes to holding register 11.
While the ML-SER tool is connected the device is disconnected from the Modbus network.
